attribution.notice: Non-alcoholic ingredient classes and nominal example drinks: written for Drink Builder from docs/non-alcoholic.md, AGPL-3.0-or-later. Every ABV, sugar, acid and shelf-life value carries its evidence status; values without a source stay absent.

specs.name: Nominal low-ABV stirred drink (example)
specs.notes: Nominal example of the template low-stirred: 2 parts fortified wine (line role base) to 1 part vermouth, the Martini's nominal ratio. Under the default thresholds its calculated ABV is above 10 %, so it counts as standard, not low; the class is computed, see docs/non-alcoholic.md.

source.name: Mixtura
source.note: Nominal example of a template variant (docs/seed-data.md, Mixtura's own additions): built from the template's nominal ratios, not a classic and not a tested recipe.
